title: Words: describe changes and communicate
subtitle: A2 · Unit 7: Health appointments and getting help

steps.exampleFr: Je vais décrire le changement depuis hier.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to describe the change since yesterday.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais ajouter l'heure du début du symptôme.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to add the time when the symptom began.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais indiquer la durée sur le formulaire.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to indicate the duration on the form.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais consulter un professionnel de la santé.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to consult a health professional.

steps.exampleFr: Le service va me rappeler demain.
steps.exampleEn: The service is going to call me back tomorrow.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais transmettre le résultat au professionnel.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to pass the result to the professional.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais compléter le formulaire avant l'appel.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to complete the form before the call.

steps.exampleFr: Je vais noter les consignes et la date du suivi.
steps.exampleEn: I am going to write down the instructions and the follow-up date.

steps.explain: rappeler means to call back; remind.
transmettre means to pass on; send.

steps.title: Words: describe changes and communicate
steps.body: Health-service routes, fees and referral steps differ by province and territory. The clinic and examples here are fictional and are not medical advice. For a real health concern, use the official provincial or territorial health service; urgent or severe symptoms need prompt help from local emergency services.
